mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, source_id, source_code, source_type, type, partner_id, partner_nickname, feedback_url, so_code, so_id, so_org_id, so_org_name, so_outstock_id, so_outstock_code, so_outstock_date, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, partition_id, partition_name, sku_id, sku_no, qty, currency, currency_symbol, exchange_rate, total_cost, product_cost, first_mile_shipping_cost, clearance_customs_tax, shipping_cost, customs_tax, other_cost
mapper.select:
WITH kolFeedback as ( select array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT partner_id),',') as partner_id, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT partner_nickname),',') as partner_nickname, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT url),',') as url, source_detail_id from kol_feedback where is_deleted = false group by source_detail_id ) select sba.source_code, sba.source_id, sba.source_type, sba.so_detail_id, sba.partition_id, kfb.partner_id, kfb.partner_nickname, kfb.url as feedback_url from (select kba.code as source_code, kba.id as source_id, 'kolB2bApplication' as source_type, sd.id as so_detail_id, si.partition_id, kbad.id as detailId from kol_b2b_application kba inner join kol_b2b_application_detail kbad on kba.id = kbad.main_id and kbad.is_deleted = false inner join so_info si on si.source_id = kba.id and si.is_deleted = false inner join so_detail sd on sd.source_detail_id = kbad.id and sd.is_deleted = false where kba.is_deleted = false
union
select kba.code as source_code, kba.id as source_id, 'kolB2cApplication' as source_type, sbd.id as so_detail_id, sbr.partition_id, kbad.id as detailId from kol_b2c_application kba inner join kol_b2c_application_detail kbad on kba.id = kbad.main_id and kbad.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_detail sbd on sbd.source_detail_id = kbad.id and sbd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sbr on sbd.main_id = sbr.main_id and sbr.is_deleted = false where kba.is_deleted = false ) sba left join kolFeedback kfb on sba.detailId = kfb.source_detail_id
